card.name: Inside the drug name risperidone
card.fires_on: The pieces 'isper' or 'per' partway through the antipsychotic name risperidone (and its brand Risperdal), usually in lists of antipsychotics. Also fires once on 'SP' in 'RSPCA'.

modes.label: Risperidone spelling
modes.description: The middle piece of risperidone or Risperdal when it is split into parts, within antipsychotic lists.

modes.label: Capitalized start
modes.description: The piece after a capital R at the start of Risperidone or Risperdal.
modes.example: Second-generation antipsychotics, such as risperidone (R<<isper>>dal) and aripiprazole

modes.label: RSPCA
modes.description: A stray hit on the letters inside the charity name RSPCA.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of the drug name risperidone when the name is written in pieces.
